name: Five Years
source:
Five years after school main character becomes a suspect in a murder case after return from overseas. The group of his school friends offer cooperation in resolving the case to clear his charges. But as investigation approaches the core, it becomes evident that one of the friends is the culprit.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/02/vn-of-month-january-2001.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
离开学校五年后，主人公从海外归来，却成了一起谋杀案的嫌疑人。昔日同窗纷纷表示愿意协助调查，帮助他洗清罪名。然而随着调查逐渐接近核心，众人发现真凶其实就在这群朋友之中。

[摘自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/02/vn-of-month-january-2001.html]vndbreview[/url]]
